The '''E-Web rifle''' was a portable version of the powerful [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] designed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It was used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The E-Web rifle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It was added to the game on [[November 20]], [[2008]] as part of the [[W:c:swg:Battle of Echo Base|Battle of Echo Base]] [[W:c:swg:Instance|instance]] added with [[W:c:swg:Chapter 11|Chapter 11]].
